ukmt-smc-2020-02.prompt: What is the remainder when $1234\times5678$ is divided by 5?

ukmt-smc-2020-03.prompt: A shape is made from five unit cubes, as shown. What is the surface area of the shape?

ukmt-smc-2020-04.prompt: The numbers $p$, $q$, $r$ and $s$ satisfy the equations $p=2$, $p\times q=20$, $p\times q\times r=202$ and $p\times q\times r\times s=2020$. What is the value of $p+q+r+s$?

ukmt-smc-2020-06.prompt: There are fewer than 30 students in the A-level mathematics class. One half of them play the piano, one quarter play hockey and one seventh are in the school play. How many of the students play hockey?

ukmt-smc-2020-07.prompt: Official UK accident statistics showed that there were 225 accidents involving teapots in one year. However, in the following year there were 47 such accidents. What was the approximate percentage reduction in recorded accidents involving teapots from the first year to the second?

ukmt-smc-2020-08.prompt: What is the largest prime factor of $106^2-15^2$?

ukmt-smc-2020-09.prompt: In 2018, a racing driver was allowed to use the Drag Reduction System provided that the car was within 1 second of the car ahead. Suppose that two cars were 1 second apart, each travelling at 180 km/h (in the same direction!). How many metres apart were they?

ukmt-smc-2020-10.prompt: Six friends Pat, Qasim, Roman, Sam, Tara and Uma, stand in a line for a photograph. There are three people standing between Pat and Qasim, two between Qasim and Roman and one between Roman and Sam. Sam is not at either end of the line. How many people are standing between Tara and Uma?

ukmt-smc-2020-11.prompt: Two congruent pentagons are each formed by removing a right-angled isosceles triangle from a square of side-length 1. The two pentagons are then fitted together as shown. What is the length of the perimeter of the octagon formed?

ukmt-smc-2020-12.prompt: A three-piece suit consists of a jacket, a pair of trousers and a waistcoat. Two jackets and three pairs of trousers cost £380. A pair of trousers costs the same as two waistcoats. What is the cost of a three-piece suit?

ukmt-smc-2020-13.prompt: The number $16!\div2^k$ is an odd integer. Note that $n!=1\times2\times3\times\cdots\times(n-1)\times n$. What is the value of $k$?

ukmt-smc-2020-14.prompt: Diane has five identical blue disks, two identical red disks and one yellow disk. She wants to place them on the grid opposite so that each cell contains exactly one disk. The two red disks are not to be placed in cells that share a common edge. How many different-looking completed grids can she produce?

ukmt-smc-2020-15.prompt: The shaded area shown in the diagram consists of the interior of a circle of radius 3 together with the area between the circle and two tangents to the circle. The angle between the tangents at the point where they meet is $60^\circ$. What is the shaded area?

ukmt-smc-2020-16.prompt: Which diagram represents the set of all points $(x,y)$ satisfying $y^2-2y=x^2+2x$?

ukmt-smc-2020-17.prompt: The positive integers $m$, $n$ and $p$ satisfy the equation $3m+\dfrac{3}{n+\frac1p}=17$. What is the value of $p$?

ukmt-smc-2020-18.prompt: Two circles $C_1$ and $C_2$ have their centres at the point $(3,4)$ and touch a third circle, $C_3$. The centre of $C_3$ is at the point $(0,0)$ and its radius is 2. What is the sum of the radii of the two circles $C_1$ and $C_2$?

ukmt-smc-2020-19.prompt: The letters $p$, $q$, $r$, $s$ and $t$ represent different positive single-digit numbers such that $p-q=r$ and $r-s=t$. How many different values could $t$ have?

ukmt-smc-2020-20.prompt: The real numbers $x$ and $y$ satisfy the equations $4^y=\dfrac{1}{8(\sqrt2)^{x+2}}$ and $9^x\times3^y=3\sqrt3$. What is the value of $5^{x+y}$?

ukmt-smc-2020-21.prompt: When written out in full, the number $(10^{2020}+2020)^2$ has 4041 digits. What is the sum of the digits of this 4041-digit number?

ukmt-smc-2020-22.prompt: A square with perimeter 4 cm can be cut into two congruent right-angled triangles and two congruent trapezia as shown in the first diagram in such a way that the four pieces can be rearranged to form the rectangle shown in the second diagram. What is the perimeter, in centimetres, of this rectangle?

ukmt-smc-2020-23.prompt: A function $f$ satisfies $y^3f(x)=x^3f(y)$ and $f(3)\ne0$. What is the value of $\dfrac{f(20)-f(2)}{f(3)}$?

ukmt-smc-2020-24.prompt: In the diagram shown, $M$ is the mid-point of $PQ$. The line $PS$ bisects $\angle RPQ$ and intersects $RQ$ at $S$. The line $ST$ is parallel to $PR$ and intersects $PQ$ at $T$. The length of $PQ$ is 12 and the length of $MT$ is 1. The angle $SQT$ is $120^\circ$. What is the length of $SQ$?

ukmt-smc-2020-25.prompt: A regular $m$-gon, a regular $n$-gon and a regular $p$-gon share a vertex and pairwise share edges, as shown in the diagram. What is the largest possible value of $p$?
